objective: Better evidence search (package A5.1): sixty hand-written questions with the records that answer them, in six groups (rules, paraphrases that avoid the record's words, measured pitfalls, leakage precedents, experiments, workflow and findings), and recall at 5 for keyword search, a vector search and their hybrid. The product uses the hybrid only if it is not worse on any group.
rule: Recall on one hand-written question set about one index; a group of 6 to 15 questions moves by about 0.1 per question.
